author: Epic Games
description:
STAR WARS: Galactic Racer is a ​runs-based, ​high-stakes reinvention of racing born in the Outer Rim. 

With the Empire gone and the galaxy rebuilding, The Galactic League is created: an underground, unsanctioned circuit where syndicates bankroll chaos and champions are forged.

Get it now on the Epic Games Store and may the Force be with you! https://epic.gm/swgalacticracer
